The issue was caused by [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L53) in [Tokenizer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts) unconditionally resetting `lexer.state.inLink = false` after tokenizing inner text instead of restoring the previous `inLink` state. When an inline or reference-style image was parsed inside a link's label, the nested `outputLink` call for the image cleared `lexer.state.inLink`, allowing [`_Lexer.#inlineTokensInner`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r2/work/src/Lexer.ts#L510-L515) to run [`_Tokenizer.url`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L1028-L1064) on subsequent bare URLs/emails inside the outer link.

### Fix
- Saved `lexer.state.inLink` in `outerInLink` before setting `lexer.state.inLink = true` in [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L22-L30) and restored `lexer.state.inLink = outerInLink` afterward.
